headline: Firebird opens region’s largest AI Factory in Armenia, backed by Nvidia chipsets
summary: Investing.com - U.S.-based AI cloud infrastructure provider Firebird officially launched the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) region’s largest AI Factory in Hrazdan, Armenia, on Saturday, marking the operational debut of a multi-billion-dollar global computing platform.
